items.text: Adopt a two-menu UI with a button menu and an LCD/options menu, two function layers (basic and advanced) organized into a display group and a basic functions group with a dividing line, plus two extra buttons, four-way navigation, and an OK/back scheme; the screen should be placed on top of the remote layout.
items.owner_cue: So we need two menus kind of thing.

items.text: The UI will design the LCD screen function menu and create a multi-page menu layout.
items.owner_cue: The User Interface Designer can design a menu for all these function.

items.text: The layout of the remote will be designed by ID (MTD022ID).
items.owner_cue: So he's layout and you're function

items.text: The UI designer will create maps of the data gathered for the project.
items.owner_cue: And uh we have to make uh some maps with uh with the all the the data we uh gathered

items.text: There is a potential conflict about feature priorities across age groups that could lead to scope ambiguity.

items.text: Ownership boundaries are unclear for logo and microphone decisions.
